$comment: Pullback opportunity screen. Thresholds are percentages. Lists: config/universe/*.csv (pnpm collect universe-refresh). Watchlist and holdings (stocks) are added from the database at runtime.

universe.$extraComment: Large S&P 500 members the market-cap ranking can't size (shares reported per class only).
universe.$excludeComment: Second share classes of companies already listed (one alert per company).

checks.$comment: America/New_York. EOD reuses the close check (20 min after the close; 60 min after an early close) so official SIP closes are available.

$predecessorComment: Ticker -> earlier SEC CIKs whose history is merged in (the newer entity wins on overlapping periods).
